definitions.hansenTreeCover: Tree cover from the Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change dataset (30 m Landsat): canopy cover in 2000 minus the canopy lost since 2001, as a percent of the area. Regrowth is not counted, so it can only go down.
definitions.modisTreeCover: Tree cover from NASA MODIS MOD44B Vegetation Continuous Fields: a yearly estimate at 250 m. It reads about 22 points lower than Hansen over dense forest, and its product year runs March to March, so compare its change over time, not its level.
definitions.lossKm2: Area (km2) with stand-replacing tree cover loss in the year, from Hansen. It includes fire, logging, mining and clearing, not only deforestation.
definitions.burnedKm2: Area (km2) burned in the calendar year, summed over its 12 months, from NASA MODIS MCD64A1 burned area.

flags.note: MOD44B 2025 drops about 3 points in cells with no Hansen loss; treat as suspect.

trendMethod: Trends of Hansen yearly tree cover loss (2001-2025) and MODIS tree cover (2000-2024; 2025 excluded as suspect). Hansen tree cover itself is not tested because it can only go down by construction. Each cell: Mann-Kendall test on the yearly values (original test; autocorrelation shares 16% and 10%), Sen's slope times 10 per decade (km² per year, and % of cell), and Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate across all tested cells with q < 0.05 (significant). pValue is the raw p-value. Generated by the SIGNO pipeline (pipeline/), code written with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code following the team's choices; values come only from the cited NASA and Hansen/UMD datasets.
